name: Servcorp Limited
summary: Servcorp Limited provides executive serviced and virtual offices, coworking and IT, communications, and secretarial services in Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, North Asia, and internationally. The company offers office space solutions; and virtual office services, including business address, phone number, call handling, mail forwarding, and secretarial and receptionist services. It also provides co-working and meeting room services. Servcorp Limited was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
